host: One EC2 c7i.4xlarge in us-west-2, Intel Xeon Platinum 8488C, Linux 7.0.0-1018-aws. Single CPU per process; trials on different physical cores could overlap. The parent and shipping series both used CPU 0. Full process wall and maximum RSS from GNU time.
command: dive validate-trace Prepared.tla --config BadN.cfg --trace FN.trace --output json
source_recipe: Extend TCommit with NonePrepared == \A participant \in RM : rmState[participant] # "prepared". Keep TCTypeOK, TCConsistent and NonePrepared. Set RM={r1,...,rN}. First concrete state has all working, second has r1 prepared, with ending invariant NonePrepared. In the forged second state both r1 and r2 prepare in a single step. The original action updates one owner.

variants.index: Experiment: hash position per model-value key, original pair quantifier.
variants.factor: Experiment: same allocated index and factored pair tests.
variants.certified: Sorted/dense model key lookup with constant-size retained descriptor and conservative cross-interner handling, plus first-column short circuit.
variants.shipping: Same certification and quantifier, with fallible reservation for temporary duplicate-text detection.

controls.memory: 128 separately constructed 1,024-entry maps. On the hash-map experiment, RSS went from 7,160 to 11,512 KiB after accessing one key of each table. The final retained index has no per-key array. Canonical certificate trial: 7,140 to 7,140 KiB. Token-ordered trial: 7,116 to 7,148 KiB, including temporary allocation and allocator retention.
controls.early_witness: 8,192 repetitions over a 1,000-entry domain: distinct status witness in the first quantifier column. The allocating full-scan version took 0.17 s, the revised first-column path 0.01 s and parent 0.02 s. Both polarities checked.
controls.validated: Original and forged steps, false invariant claim, swapped and shared binders, INSTANCE substitutions, partial and heterogeneous ranges, differently typed model keys, cross-interner equal text at different tokens, deferred providers, and cancellation token 7001.
controls.goldens: Six Examples configurations at one worker in default and TLC profiles: TCommit, TwoPhase, MCPaxos, MCVoting, SimplifiedFastPaxos/Paxos and FastPaxos. Zero small-tier ratchet regressions.
